Question 4
?

Find the fundamental vector product of the surface generated by the vector-valued function r(u,v)=⟨sin⁡u,v2,4vcos⁡u⟩.

a
⟨8v2sin⁡u,−4cos2⁡u,2vcos⁡u⟩
b
⟨cos⁡u,0,−4vsin⁡u⟩
c
⟨0,4cos2⁡u,vcos⁡u⟩
d
⟨8v2sin⁡u,4cos2⁡u,2vcos⁡u⟩
e
⟨0,−4cos2⁡u,vcos⁡u⟩
